import sys

MOD = 1_000_000_007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    
    a = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    b = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    for sum_val in range(2 * n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(n + 1):
            j = sum_val - i
            if j < 0 or j > i:
                continue
            if i == n and j == n:
                continue
            
            if i == j:
                a[i][j] = max(1 + b[i + 1][j], a[i + 1][j])
                b[i][j] = a[i + 1][j]
            elif i == n:
                a[i][j] = max(1 + b[i][j + 1], a[i][j + 1])
                b[i][j] = a[i][j + 1]
            else:
                downA = a[i + 1][j]
                rightA = a[i][j + 1]
                downB = b[i + 1][j]
                rightB = b[i][j + 1]
                v1 = (downA + rightA) % MOD
                v2 = (1 + downB + rightA) % MOD
                v3 = (1 + downA + rightB) % MOD
                a[i][j] = max(v1, v2, v3)
                b[i][j] = v1
    
    print(a[0][0] % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
